## Publication

For a package-file PR, the maintainer fills in the final pinned commit and checksum after merge; leave `catalog.json` unchanged.

For an externally hosted package or catalog-only PR:

- Public repository (`owner/repository`):
- Existing full 40-character commit SHA:
- Repository-relative JSON path:
- SHA-256 of the exact committed file bytes:
- Public license URL:

Please write the PR title and description in English. Do not include personal data or credentials.
